case_title: Arun Kumar v. The State of Bihar & Ors.
neutral_facts: The prosecution case is that on 24.07.1991, the informant and others were attacked by a group of accused persons who were armed with guns and lathis. The attack resulted in the death of one person and injuries to others. The accused fled with the dead body. The cause of the incident was that the accused had previously cut and stolen barbed wire from the informant's field. The informant recognized the accused persons and provided statements to the police. The police recorded statements from witnesses and collected evidence from the crime scene. The trial court acquitted all accused persons, and the High Court dismissed the appeal. The Supreme Court remanded the case to the High Court for a fresh hearing on the merits.
